verdict.rationale: An employer tax portal like EAMS/eServices could plausibly offer bulk operations, such as bulk wage-file uploads or multi-account management for representing firms, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows single-report filing, single-employer setup videos, and a generic line that firms can 'manage many tasks in eServices', which is not a bulk-operation capability. Probes found no API or OpenAPI spec, and the transactional portal sits behind a login wall.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
